arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
transliteration: Bismillahi walajna, wabismillahi kharajna, wa'ala Rabbina tawakkalna.
translation: In the Name of Allah we enter, in the Name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we depend [then say As-Salamu 'Alaykum to those present].
